# Draft:Leon Software

Leon Software is a Polish cloud-based aviation software provider headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. The company develops software used by aviation operators for flight scheduling, crew management, charter sales, maintenance planning, and report preparation.
In May 2022, Global Jet selected Leon Software for sales, operations, and crew management. In August 2022, Leon Software entered into a partnership with Jetex to integrate its flight scheduling system with Jetex’s trip planning services.
In February 2023, the platform was integrated with ASQS, a provider of web-based safety, quality, and risk management systems.
In May 2023, Tag Aviation adopted Leon Software as its aviation software solution. The company also partnered with Euro Jet, a flight support services provider.
In December 2024, the company also integrated with UAS International Trip Support, a flight support services provider.
In September 2025, the company announced the integration of a Model Context Protocol server to support AI-based features within the platform. Later that year, Leon Marketplace was launched, enabling in-platform flight trading. By 2025, Leon Software reported having 500 customers worldwide.
In January 2026, an integration between Leon Software and SkyAccess was announced.
